The log line prints a fixed message and the exception class name only; the word 'password'/'token'/'secret' is part of the message text, no credential value is logged.

Intentional defensive masking. The step builds a base64 authorization header from GH_TOKEN, which GitHub does not mask on its own because it is a derived value, and masks it before the git push so it can never appear in a log. Nothing here disables workflow commands (no stop-commands) and no user-controlled text is echoed into the command; the value comes from the workflow token only.

Deliberate: the recorder's data directory is 0750 (owner full, group read and traverse, no access for others) so the owner's weekly copy-back can read it through the dedicated recorder group; files are 0640 and the process umask is 027. The rule flags any mode above 0644 on a directory; no world access is granted.
